scope: Field-wide molecular generation/optimizationRL extension; no privileged model/algorithm choice. Read-only primarysource/code metadata review.

sources.title: Learning to Navigate The Synthetically Accessible Chemical Space Using Reinforcement Learning
sources.verified_scope: PGFS; reaction-based MDP, continuous reactant representation with environment nearest-neighbor selection, TD3 training.
sources.limits: Virtual synthesis feasibility is model-relative; only benign methodological/property context used, not paper biological-target design cases. Apollo1060 source mentioned for case data/predictors, full training code not confirmed.

sources.title: Molecular Design in Synthetically Accessible Chemical Space via Deep Reinforcement Learning
sources.verified_scope: REACTOR A2C; action masks, reaction templates and stop; heuristic reactant/product selection collapsed into environment; terminal feedback.
sources.limits: Routes are theoretical; original text admits route not necessarily chemist first choice. Full official training repo not verified.

sources.title: Directly optimizing for synthesizability in generative molecular design using retrosynthesis models
sources.verified_scope: Retrosynthesis directly in optimization loop; wall-time/heuristic comparison; domain-dependent value of explicit planning.
sources.limits: Do not replace solved-by-planner with experimental synthesis. Search intermediary gave inconsistent date; publisher PDF explicitly says21March2025.

sources.title: TANGO: direct optimization of constrained synthesizability for generative molecular design
sources.verified_scope: Continuous similarity/substructure feedback on predicted route nodes for starting-material, intermediate and divergent synthesis constraints; used with RL generation.
sources.limits: Synthesizable explicitly means deemed by retrosynthesis model; no wet-lab validation inferred. Nature direct open redirected; publisher/PMC indexed full text read. TANGO* is a different synthesis planning work.

sources.title: SynFlowNet: Design of Diverse and Novel Molecules with Synthesis Constraints
evidence_location: Paper synthesis MDP and backward-policy methods
sources.verified_scope: GFlowNet over reactions and purchasable reactants; independent retrosynthesis evaluation and backward-policy challenges.
sources.limits: Computational synthesis assessment, not demonstrated synthesis for every generated molecule; no runtime verification.

sources.title: Generative Flows on Synthetic Pathway for Drug Design
evidence_location: Abstract and methods on action subsampling
sources.verified_scope: RxnFlow reaction-based GFlowNet and action subsampling for large building-block action spaces.
sources.limits: Conference paper, workshop/arXiv versions and current README may differ; no numeric claims pooled. Docking and planner outputs remain proxies.

sources.title: Compositional Flows for 3D Molecule and Synthesis Pathway Co-design
sources.venue_or_status: ICML2025 confirmed by author official repository
evidence_location: AppendixA compositional and state flow recipe
sources.verified_scope: CGFlow combines compositional structure/synthesis decisions with continuous3D state flows; GFlowNet reward-guided compositional objective.
sources.limits: Molecule/pose/route co-design is computational, not wet-lab; official README distinguishes current application code from submission version.

sources.title: Aligning Target-Aware Molecule Diffusion Models with Exact Energy Optimization
sources.verified_scope: AliDiff aligns target-conditioned diffusion models with energy preferences and regularized distribution matching.
sources.limits: Oracle-derived preferences not human feedback; Vina score is not measured affinity. No inference or generated structures.

sources.title: Decomposed Direct Preference Optimization for Structure-Based Drug Design
sources.venue_or_status: TMLR2025, inspected arXivv3 and journal PDFheader
sources.verified_scope: DecompDPO molecular/substructure preference pairs for diffusion model alignment and targeted subpocket optimization.
sources.limits: Computational validation; do not equate named High Affinity metric with experimental binding.

sources.title: Guiding Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning for Stable Molecule Generation
evidence_location: §4 RLPF: denoising MDP, policy gradient and physical reward
sources.verified_scope: RLPF DDPO/PPO-style fine-tuning with force-field stability feedback.
sources.limits: Force-field/geometry metrics not measured biological efficacy; no local reproduction.

sources.title: Controllable molecular generation with fine-tuned flow-matching model
sources.verified_scope: SemlaFlow reward-weighted FM objective, online sampling/scoring, continuous/discrete features and learnable molecule-size sampler; prior regularization.
sources.limits: Not the same objective as clipped PPO; parameter proximity is not automatically distributionalKL. Properties/predictors/interaction scores remain computational.

sources.title: Graph-GRPO: Training Graph Flow Models with Reinforcement Learning
sources.verified_scope: Discrete graph flow model onlineGRPO, analytical transition probabilities, perturbation/regeneration refinement.
sources.limits: Not3D coordinate generation; not same-title multiagent topology paper. Reported molecular benchmarks use proxies; official environment/runtime claims are author reports, not reproduced.

sources.title: Targeted molecular generation with latent reinforcement learning
sources.verified_scope: Fixed encoder–decoder, learned PPO policy for continuous latent modifications; one-step reward setting; per-batch repeated updates are described as off-line steps.
sources.limits: Not strict fixed-dataset offlineRL. Predictive/property tasks, not new wet-lab efficacy. No runtime validation.

related_existing_sources: ClassicSMILES/graph/fragmentRL, originalGFlowNet, PMO/ACEGEN, DPO/ERA and conditional examples are recorded in rl_method_sources.json.
